title: Reset Bounding Volumes (ver4.2.0)
content: **Objective** Reset Bounding Volumes to the original placement after adjustments. ** Location** Main Menu ▶ Avatar ▶ Avatar Editor ▶ Arrangement ▶ Bounding Volume ▶ ![____10.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360003078947/____10.png) **Reset Bounding Volumes** ** Operation** 1. title: 3D Garment Information (ver4.1.0 and Above)
content: **List of Contents** Enter Default Garment Information Add Category Reorder Category Delete Category **Objective** Write and check important Garment information. **Location ** Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Information ▶ **Garment** ** Operation** **Enter Default Garment Information** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Information ▶ **Garment** → The Garment Information window appears. → Four categories: StyleNumber, Name, Description, Fabric, Colorway, and Size appear by default. 2. Click the ![edit_configurator.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360000717328/edit_configurator.png) **Edit** icon on the right top corner of the window. → The Garment Information window changed to the edit mode. 3. Type in necessary information next to each category and click **OK**. → Typed in information is saved. **Add Category** 1. Refer to Enter Default Garment Information manual to active the edit mode. 2. Click the ![plus_button.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360000717348/plus_button.png) **Add** icon. → A category is added. Click the drop-down menu and select desired category. → There are eleven categories to choose from: StyleNumber, Name, Description, Fabric, Colorway, Size, Category, Memo, SizeMemo, Price, and SizeChart. 3. Type in necessary information for each category and click **OK**. → Typed in information is saved. **Reorder Category** 1. Refer to Enter Default Garment Information manual to active the edit mode.. 2. Click and drag the category to the desired position. → The category is moved to where the mouse is released. 3. When categories are re-ordered completely, click **OK**. → Revised category order is saved. **Delete Category** 1. Refer to Enter Default Garment Information manual to active the edit mode. 2. Click the ![____16.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360000728667/____16.png) **Delete** icon next to each category. → The selected category is deleted. 3. When the editing is completed, click **OK**. → The deleted category no longer appears in the Garment Information window. **※ Note: ** * Toggle on **Display When Garment File Loads** option to open the Garment Information window every time the file opens. * Open or save Garment information such as categories, order, and contents by using the **![open.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360000717468/open.png)Open** and **![save.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360000717528/save.png)Save** buttons on the right top corner of the edit mode. * Use the [Default File setting](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002563607-%EA%B8%B0%EB%B3%B8-%ED%8C%8C%EC%9D%BC-%EC%84%A4%EC%A0%95) to designate default Garment Information file. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for entering, managing, and organizing essential garment information, including adding, reordering, and deleting categories.

title: Edit 2D Seam Allowance Properties
content: **List of Contents** Seam Allowance Properties Edit Seam Allowance Properties **Seam Allowance Properties YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-h8AbhskRO0 **\- Edit properties of seam allowances as needed. \- Navigate to the Main Menu and select 2D Pattern ▶ Create ▶ **Seam Allowance** \- Select the![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115026411067/mceclip0.png) **Seam Allowance** tool from the 2D toolbar. ** Edit Seam Allowance Properties YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mO5VFzXGDMQ ** \- Select the Pattern outline or the Internal Line of the seam allowance to be edited. \- The seam allowance is selected and its Pattern outline or Internal Line is highlighted. \- The selected seam allowance’s properties appear in the Property Editor. * **Width** \- Modify the width of the seam allowance as needed. * **Seam Type** \- Choose the seam type of a seam allowance’s start, end, and intersection. \- Options are activated or deactivated depending on the selected point. * **Start** \- This option activates when only one seam allowance is created on either end of the selected segment. \- Choose the desired type of the seam among three options. * **End** \- This option activates when only one seam allowance is created on either end of the selected segment. \- Choose the desired type of the seam among three options. * **Intersection** \- This option activates when seam allowances are created on both ends of the selected segment. \- Choose the desired type of the seam among six options. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: Explore how to edit and customize seam allowance properties in your 2D patterns with this comprehensive guide and instructional videos.

title: V-Ray Render
content: **List of Contents** V-Ray Render Interactive Render Stop Render Final Render (Image/Video) **V-Ray Render ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G_iLtOplSN8 \- Produce more vivid and photorealistic images with clear seamlines and puckerings. \- Navigate to the Main Menu and select Render ▶**Render ** \- Or, navigate to the Main Menu ▶ Display ▶ Window ▶ **Render** ** Interactive Render YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JZFqnDkqXW8 ** \- By default, the ![stop_render.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115025910647/stop_render.png) **Stop Render** tool is activated when the Render window opens. \- Click the ![interactive_render.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115025949628/interactive_render.png) **Interactive Render** tool on the 2D toolbar or click the message, “Click here to start the Interactive Render” to start rendering. \- Render Garments and Avatars in the 3D window in real-time with the Interactive Render tool. \- Any changes in 3D view are also reflected in the Render window. **Stop Render ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D0tfZYSP8gI \- Click the ![stop_render.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115025910647/stop_render.png) **Stop Render** tool to temporarily pause while rendering. \- Rendering is paused in the Render window. \- Any changes in the 3D window do not reflect in the Render window when the ![stop_render.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115025910647/stop_render.png) **Stop Render** tool is activated. \- Click the ![interactive_render.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115025949628/interactive_render.png) **Interactive Render** tool to resume real time rendering. **Final Render (Image/Video) ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZR4xFcfkb1k \- The image shown in the Render window is a preview of real time Render, which Render settings are not fully applied. \- To extract the final Render images or a video with Render settings fully applied, click the ![final_render.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115025910747/final_render.png) **Final Render (Image/Video)** tool. \- The progress of the rendering appears on the right top corner of the Render toolbar. \- When rendering is completed, the Information window appears, informing the images or video have been saved. \- Select the **Open the Folder** button to open the folder where the final output is saved. \- The final output is automatically saved to the saving path assigned in the **Image/Video Properties.** \- **Image/Video Properties** , **Light Properties** , and**Render Properties** are fully applied to the final render output. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage serves as a comprehensive guide to V-Ray rendering techniques, including interactive, final, and stop rendering, complete with instructional videos and step-by-step instructions for achieving photorealistic images and videos.

title: Pressure
content: **List of Contents** Pressure Set Pressure **Pressure** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bZ80DpGG2VM \- Assign Pressure to Patterns to express inflated Garments/accessories such as padded jumpers, balloons, pillows, and cushions. \- Navigate to the Property Editor ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ **Pressure** ** Set Pressure** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mFQ1NX4_mo8 \- Using the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022740708/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool, select the Pattern to be edited. \- Navigate to the Property Editor ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ **Pressure.** \- When the Pressure value is positive, the Pressure is applied to the back of the fabric, but when the Pressure value is negative, the Pressure is applied to the front of the fabric. \- Assign values to Pressure so that the outside Pattern’s Pressure value is 10 and the inside Pattern’s value is -10. Be mindful that the absolute value for two Patterns should be the same. \- When the **Simulation** is activated, the Patterns will inflate. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for assigning and adjusting pressure values to garment patterns for simulating inflated effects in design software.

title: Lock All Patterns
content: **Lock All Patterns** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sUvT9te3Egk \- Lock all Patterns to inhibit selecting and editing in the 2D window and easily select and edit Internal Lines. \- Right-click on the 2D window and select **Lock All Patterns** from the pop-up menu. All Patterns will turn grey and be deactivated. \- Only activated Internal Lines can be selected and edited. **Lock Selected Patterns_ver5.0.0 and Above** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lnes6ySjf1U \- Select the ![Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Transform.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360021137913/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Transform.png) **Transform Pattern** or the ![Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360021137933/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png) **Edit Pattern** tool. \- Right click on the Pattern to be locked and select **Lock Pattern** from the right-click pop-up menu. \- The selected Pattern and all Internal Lines within are locked and cannot be selected. \- The selected Pattern and Internal Lines turn grey. \- To unlock the Pattern, right click on the 2D window and select **Unlock All Pattern Outlines.**

content: **Objective** Set arrangement property details once arranging patterns with Arrangement Points. **Location** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![Toolbar_3D_Select_Move.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024671748/Toolbar_3D_Select_Move.png) **Select/Move** ▶ Select 3D Pattern ▶ Property Editor ▶ **Arrangement ** **※ Note:** The arrangement properties are only accessible to Patterns that are arranged by Arrangement Points. **Operation** 1. title: Guide for Installing Network Version on the Internet Environment
content: **List of Contents** Guideline for Installing Network Version on the Internet Environment 1\. Set up on Server PC 2\. Set up on Client PC **Guide for Installing Network Version on the Internet Environment** **Objective** Set up CLO 3D/Marvelous Designer Network Version on the Internet environment. Note that you do not need to follow the set-up guidelines below when a Server PC and Client PC are under the same local network environment. Simply plugging the dongle key into a Server PC enables you to run CLO 3D or Marvelous Designer on any PCs under the same local network as the Server PC located without any extra settings. **1\. Set-up on Server PC** **Operation** 1. **Plug the dongle key in the Server PC and install the HASP Driver. ** HASP Driver gets automatically installed during the software installation. However if any trouble occurs during the process or in case of Server only being connected with the dongle key, HASP Driver should be installed manually. [Guideline for Sentinel HASP Driver Manual Installation ](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000558507) 2. **Make sure Port 1947 is open in the firewall. ** Port 1947 should automatically be opened once the HASP Driver gets installed however, occasionally it fails to open the port in certain PCs. In this case, go to the firewall settings and open the port manually. Port 1947 is being used for communication between the Client PC and dongle key in the Server PC in order to get an authentication. Setting methods varies considerably in the types of firewall, therefore please ask for support from your network manager. 3. **Make sure the local IP address of the Server is static. (Local IP is dynamically allocated Intranet IP by the router.) ** The local IP address gets changed when the router is restarted if the local IP is not set in static status. To avoid repetitive IP reset in the process, 'port forwarding', set your Server's local IP as 'static'. 4. **Port-forward Port 1947 for TCP and UDP of the Server's local IP in the router setting. ** Port-forwarding enables to transmit the data from Client/Server to Server/Client through Port 1947. Port-forwarding method varies considerably in the types of router therefore please ask for support from your network manager. **※ Note:** <http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Port_forwarding> [ http://www.wikihow.com/Set-up-Port-Forwarding-on-a-Router](http://www.wikihow.com/Set-up-Port-Forwarding-on-a-Router) **2\. Set-up on Client PC** **Operation** 1. Run CLO 3D/Marvelous Designer Network Version installer. 2. Make sure Port 1947 is open in the firewall.** ** Port 1947 should automatically be opened once the HASP Driver gets installed however, occasionally it fails to open the port in certain PCs. In this case, go to the firewall settings and open the port manually. Port 1947 is being used for communication between the Client PC and the dongle key in the Server PC in order to get an authentication. Setting methods varies considerably in the types of firewall, therefore please ask for support from your network manager. 3. Set external IP of the Server on the dongle key configuration to let the software reaches the Server for an authentication. ** ** This can be done through Sentinel Admin Control Center which is automatically installed during the HASP Driver installation. Access to [http://localhost:1947](http://localhost:1947/) Click on 'Configuration' (the red box) ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115000785828/Clinet_1.png) 4. Click on the third tab called 'Access to Remote License Managers'. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115000737807/Clinet_2.png) 5. Make sure to check on 'Aggressive Search for Remote License' and to type the Server PC's external IP in 'Specify Search Parameters' (note that the external IP is different from the local IP mentioned in the 'Set-up on Server PC'). You are able to see the external IP of the Server PC on the website ([http://www.whatismyip.com/](http://www.whatismyip.com/)). ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115000785808/Clinet_3.png) Go Back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide for setting up the CLO 3D/Marvelous Designer Network Version in an internet environment, detailing the necessary steps for both server and client PCs to ensure successful installation and configuration.

title: [2D Tool] 1:N Segment Sewing
content: **Objective** Easily sew multiple segments (N) to a single segment (1.) If the total length of N segments and the length of 1 segment are different, the 1 segment is equally divided by the number of N segments. ** Location** Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶**Segment Sewing** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001290728/_______.png) **Segment Sewing** ** Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ **Segment Sewing** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001290728/_______.png) **Segment Sewing** 2. Select a single segment which multiple segments are sewn to. 3. Hold down the Shift key on the keyboard. → The Sewing Lines appear in neon color. 4. While holding down the Shift key on the keyboard, drag the mouse to hover over the N segments. Before clicking the segment, be careful to make Directional Notches parallel to each other. 5. Then, click on the segments to establish Sewing Lines on the N segments. 6. Release the Shift key to complete the 1:N Segment Sewing. **※ Note** * While establishing 1:N sewing lines, if you click on an inappropriate segment, the segment appears in red and the sewing line cannot be applied. * While establishing N sewing lines, hit the Delete key on the keyboard to cancel the last action or hit the Esc key on the keyboard to cancel all actions. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: Learn how to efficiently sew multiple segments to a single segment by dividing the length of the main segment according to the number of segments being sewn, ensuring a precise and streamlined sewing process.

content_description: This webpage serves as a comprehensive guide to adding, editing, and deleting free curve points in the 2D pattern editing tool, complete with instructional videos for each feature.

title: Offset as Internal Line along Curve
content: **List of Contents** Offset as Internal Line along Curve Number of Offsets Offset Distance to Segment Edge Straight Line Perpendicular Direction **Offset as Internal Line along Curve** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wrdsfSxb8gM \- Create Internal Lines between two Pattern outlines along their curve. \- Select two lines and right click to access the pop-up menu. Then, select **Offset as Internal Line along Curve.** \- With the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447008/mceclip0.png) **Edit Pattern** tool, select two lines which Internal Lines will offset In between. Then, right-click and select **Offset as Internal Line along Curve.** \- The Offset as Internal Line along Curve window will appear. ** Number of Offsets** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqyGtECwN10 \- Set how many Internal Lines will be created in between the selected lines. **Offset** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RWu6SUTyxQk \- Set the distance between the offset Internal Lines. **Distance to Segment Edge** \- Set how far the offset Internal Lines will apart from the Pattern outline. * **Reverse Direction ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OzXu1UKPEXc \- Horizontally reverse the Internal Lines’ position based on the Di"stance to Segment Edge. * **Opposite Segment** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=op3Z5EWxzUo \- Vertically reverse the Internal Lines’ position based on the Distance to Segment Edge. **Straight Line** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P-tELnIhKJQ \- Create offset Internal Lines as straight lines. **Perpendicular Direction** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OnggOP95HfM \- The offset Internal Lines will be created perpendicular to the Pattern outlines. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide to creating and customizing internal lines along curves in pattern design, featuring step-by-step instructions and accompanying video tutorials.

title: Invert Selection
content: **Invert Selection** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9eR9epYrw0Y \- Invert the Pattern selection, selecting the Patterns currently not selected. \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021445568/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool or the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021388307/mceclip1.png) **Edit Pattern** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Navigate to the 2D window and right click on the desired Pattern to select Invert Selection from the pop-up menu. \- The selection will be inverted, selecting the ones that are not currently selected.
content_description: Learn how to efficiently use the Invert Selection feature in Clo3D to toggle your pattern selections with a simple right-click in the 2D window.

title: [Property] Create Button Texture
content: ### **Objective** Create and apply custom textures to buttons in CLO in order to express various button styles. * UV maps for each default button are included in the CLO Asset Library as photoshop files. * The files can be opened and edited in Adobe Photoshop to apply custom textures and logos to the existing button shapes. * When UV maps are used, all images or type will increase or decrease in size when the button width, ligne, or thickness are changed in CLO. **Operation** 1. Download UV maps of buttons from the [Library window](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000527827-Library-Window). ![Button.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360081953953/Button.png) 2. Locate the asset folder on your computer. (**PC:** C:\Users\Public\Documents\CLO\Assets / **MAC:** User/Library/Application Support/CLO) **※ Note:** on PC you can right click on the folder name in CLO Library and choose “Copy the path”. Then you can paste this path location into a file browser to locate it. 3. Open .psd file in Adobe Photoshop. There are 4 types of layouts that UV maps will have. ![UV.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360081938953/UV.png) 4. Each part has a separate layer with a shape defining the section that needs to be filled or covered. 5. An image can be placed/embedded or a pattern [Define](https://helpx.adobe.com/photoshop/using/creating-patterns.html) and filled to cover the desired location. Type can allose be added. 6. Hide UV outlines and Text layers, then save the image. **※ Note:** Saving the image in .jpeg format is recommended. 7. Open the custom saved UV map through the Texture section of the[ button property](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115006020988--Style-Property-Apply-Custom-Button-Texture).
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide for creating and applying custom textures to buttons in CLO, utilizing UV maps available in the CLO Asset Library for personalized button styles.

title: Guide for Installing Network Version in the Same Network Envrionment
content: **List of Contents** Guideline for Installing Network Version in the Same Network Environment 1\. Check-up on HASP Driver Installation on Server PC 2\. Additional Set-up ACC Page on Client PC **Guide for Installing Network Version in the same Network Environment** **Objective** Install Network version in the same Network Environment when Server (PC connected to the red HASP Key) is unable to recognize Client (PC to run the software). **1\. Check-up on HASP Driver Installation on Server PC** **Operation** 1. Access to the Web Browser: [http://localhost:1947](http://localhost:1947/) Check Sentinel HASP Driver is installed and operating on Server as shown in the image below. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115000737867/sever_1.png) 2. If the web page does not appear, reinstall Sentinel HASP Driver. [HASP Driver Install Guide ](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/ko/articles/115000558507) **2\. Additional Set-up ACC Page on Client** **Operation** 1. Set up ACC page on PC you want to run the software. 2. ACC Page : [http://localhost:1947](http://localhost:1947/) 3. Click on **Configuration** (the red box in the image below). ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115000737927/page_add_1.jpg) 4. Click **Access to Remote License Managers**. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115000785928/page_add_2.jpg) 5. Check on 'Aggressive Search for Remote Licenses' (image below) and type the Server PC IP in "Specify Search Parameters" then click **Submit**. **※ Note:** **How to check your IP:** Windows Search ▶ Search 'Cmd.exe' ▶ Type 'ipconfig' <http://www.ghacks.net/2011/05/17/network-troubleshooting-basics-the-ipconfig-command/>[ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115000737907/page_add_3.jpg) ](http://www.ghacks.net/2011/05/17/network-troubleshooting-basics-the-ipconfig-command/) 6. Wait for 10 seconds and its completed when HASP key page shows up (image below). If the page does not show up, the Server and Client may possibly be connected to different network environment. In that case, follow the link below, follow the guideline and try again. [Guideline for Installing Network Version on the Internet Environment ](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/ko/articles/115000617048-%EC%9D%B8%ED%84%B0%EB%84%B7-%ED%99%98%EA%B2%BD%EC%97%90%EC%84%9C-Network-%EB%B2%84%EC%A0%84-%EC%84%A4%EC%B9%98-%EB%B0%A9%EB%B2%95) ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115000737887/page_add_4.png) Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide for installing the network version of software in the same network environment, ensuring proper connection between the server and client PCs.

title: Show/Hide Bond/Skive
content: ### **Objective** Show or hide bonded or skived area in the 3D window (ver2.3.0). **Location** Main Menu ▶ Display ▶ 3D Trims ▶ **Show Bond/Skive** (ver4.2 or earlier) 3D Trims Display Icon ▶ **Show Bond/Skive** (ver4.2 or earlier) Main Menu ▶ Display ▶ 3D Trims ▶ **Show Bond/Skive**(ver5.0 or later) 3D Window ▶ 3D Trims Display Icon ▶ **Show Bond/Skive** (ver5.0 or later) **Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below:** ** 3D Trims Display Icon ▶ **Show Bond/Skive** → The selected area's bond/skive in the 3D window is now being shown or hidden.
content_description: This webpage provides guidance on how to show or hide the bonded or skived area in the 3D window across different software versions.

title: [Object Browser] Delete Button Style
content: ### **Objective** Delete unnecessary button styles. **Location** Object Browser ▶ Button Tab **Operation ** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser ▶ Button Tab 2. Select a button style to be deleted. 3. Press Delete on keyboard or right click on the button style and select **Delete** option. → The selected button style is not deleted.
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide for users to effectively delete unnecessary button styles from the Object Browser's Button Tab.

title: [2D Tool] M:N Segment Sewing
content: **Objective** Easily sew multiple segments (M) to multiple segments (N) at once and edit them as a group. When the total length of multiple segments corresponding to M is different from the total length of multiple segments corresponding to N, N segments are divided in proportion to M segments. ** Location** Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ **M:N Segment Sewing** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001290748/M_N________.png) **M:N Segment Sewing** **※ Note:** Hold down the **Segment Sewing** tool for a while to access the **M:N Segment Sewing** tool. ** Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ **M:N Segment Sewing** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001290748/M_N________.png) **M:N Segment Sewing** 2. Click on the segments belong to M segments. Then, hit the Enter key on the keyboard to complete M sewing lines. → M sewing lines are highlighted in neon color. 3. As checking the Directional Notches, establish Sewing Lines on N segments. Then, hit the Enter key on the keyboard to complete. → The Sewing Lines no longer appear in neon color. **※ Note:** * While establishing M:N sewing lines, hit the Delete key on the keyboard to cancel the last action or hit the Esc key on the keyboard to cancel all actions. * When you click on an inappropriate segment while sewing, the segment appears in red and you cannot establish Sewing Line on the selected segment. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to guide users through the process of efficiently sewing multiple segments (M) to multiple segments (N) in a group, with automatic adjustments for length discrepancies.

title: Reset 3D Arrangement
content: ### **Objective** Return arrangement of the entire or selected Patterns back to pre-simulation state in the 3D window. Use this function when draping does not operate properly after arranging around the Avatar. ** Location** **Selected Pattern** 3D Pattern Right-Click Pop-Up Menu ▶ **Reset 3D Arrangement (Selected)** ****All Pattern**** Main Menu ▶ 3D Garment ▶ **Reset 3D Arrangement (All)** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001244168/_________________.png) **Reset 3D Arrangement (All)** ** Operation** **Selected Pattern** 1. Select a 3D Pattern to reset its arrangement. **※ Note:** Press Shift key on keyboard to select multiple Patterns. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Pattern Right-Click Pop-Up Menu ▶ **Reset 3D Arrangement (Selected)** → The selected Pattern is now being rearranged back to pre-simulation state. **All Pattern** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 3D Garment ▶ **Reset 3D Arrangement (All)** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001244168/_________________.png) **Reset 3D Arrangement (All)** → The entire Pattern is now being rearranged back to pre-simulation state.
content_description: This web page provides instructions for resetting the arrangement of selected or all patterns in the 3D window to their pre-simulation state to resolve draping issues.

title: Align Points
content: **Objective** Align multiple points along specific direction or axes (ver2.3.0). ** Location** Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Points) ▶ **Left / Center / Right / Top / Middle / Bottom / To Point (X-Axis) / To Point (Y-Axis)** ** Operation** 1. Navigate to 2D toolbar and select the ![2.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115001011307/2.png) **Edit Pattern** tool. 2. Select more than two points to be aligned. 3. Right click on the fiducial point and follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Points) ▶ **Left / Center / Right / Top / Middle / Bottom / To Point (X-Axis) / To Point (Y-Axis)** →The selected points are aligned according to the selected option.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide on how to align multiple points along specified directions or axes using the right-click pop-up menu in the 2D toolbar.
